name: application-two-factor-setup
title: Two-Factor Setup
description: Three-step 2FA enrollment flow: scan a QR code or copy the manual secret, enter the 6-digit authenticator code, then reveal one-time recovery codes.
useWhen: Building the enrollment flow for TOTP-based two-factor authentication in account security settings.
You need to present a QR code, a manual fallback secret, a verification step, and recovery codes as one cohesive flow.
Pairing with Input OTP's interaction pattern (auto-advance, paste-to-fill) for the verification step specifically in a 2FA context.
avoidWhen: You only need a bare verification code field with no surrounding setup flow — use Input OTP directly instead.
Your 2FA method is SMS or push-based rather than an authenticator app — the QR/secret step doesn't apply.
responsiveBehavior: The three steps stack vertically in a single column at all widths; the QR code and digit boxes stay fixed-size and center within their card rather than scaling with viewport width.
accessibility: The QR code image has role="img" with a descriptive aria-label since the visual pattern itself conveys no information to assistive technology; the manual secret text is the accessible fallback.
The digit group carries role="group" with an aria-label, and each box has its own aria-label announcing its position, matching the Input OTP pattern.
Recovery codes are rendered as selectable text (not an image) so they can be copied, read by a screen reader, or saved to a password manager.

variants.title: Two-Factor Setup
variants.description: Step 1 QR code and manual secret with a copy button, step 2 six-digit verification with a Verify and enable action, and step 3 a 6-code recovery grid with Download and Copy all actions.
accessibility: Each step is numbered and labeled with a heading so the flow's progress is clear independent of visual step styling.

variants.title: Two-Factor Setup (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-step enrollment flow adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Recovery-code text and card borders meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
